caption_used: 该组图由两个堆叠柱状图组成，分别展示了各语体中支配动词（左图a）和承受动词（右图b）的一级语义域分布。横轴包含四种语体：新闻、传统文学、网络小说和微博。左图（a）中，新闻类的总词频最高约为4,400，传统文学次之，网络小说约为4,760，微博最低。各柱状图以分段形式呈现不同语义域的占比分布。右图（b）中，传统文学的总词频显著高于其他语体，达到约5,720，网络小说次之，新闻与微博均较低。整体来看，网络小说在两个图表中均居于中等水平，未表现出明显的突出特征，而新闻和传统文学类在各自子图中占据主导地位。
raw_response:
The figure consists of two stacked bar charts, labeled (a) and (b), displaying the distribution of first-level semantic domains for governing verbs (a) and recipient verbs (b) across different corpora. The horizontal axis represents four corpora: News, Traditional Literature, Online Fiction, and Weibo. The vertical axis represents frequency, labeled in Chinese, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 7000, incrementing by 1000.

In chart (a), the total height of the bars varies across corpora. The News corpus has the shortest total bar height, approximately 4400. Traditional Literature is next, followed by Online Fiction at around 4760, and Weibo has the tallest bar, reaching approximately 6200. Each bar is segmented into colored sections representing different semantic domains. The colors include shades of blue, teal, purple, and pink. The segments within each bar indicate the proportion of each semantic domain within that corpus.

Chart (b) shows a similar stacked bar format. The total bar heights again differ across corpora. Weibo and News have the shortest total bar heights, around 700 and 845 respectively. Online Fiction is intermediate at approximately 5720, and Traditional Literature has the tallest bar, reaching around 6000. As in chart (a), each bar is divided into colored segments representing different semantic domains, using the same color scheme.

The bars are arranged horizontally in the order: News, Traditional Literature, Online Fiction, and Weibo. No bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlines, or annotations. The stacking within each bar represents the composition of each corpus in terms of the semantic domains of the verbs. The legend on the right identifies each color with a corresponding semantic domain label in Chinese.
